atoms.name: Phases, tokens and lexemes
atoms.one_line: Lexer turns characters into tokens; token is the category, lexeme the matched text.

atoms.name: Longest-match tokenising
atoms.one_line: Take the longest prefix, ties to the earlier rule; count tokens by scanning.

atoms.name: Derivations, handles, reductions
atoms.one_line: Top-down is leftmost; LR is rightmost reversed; reductions equal internal nodes.

atoms.name: FIRST sets
atoms.one_line: Terminals that can start a string; skip nullable symbols; ε if all vanish.

atoms.name: FOLLOW sets
atoms.one_line: Terminals that can come next; $ for start; inherit from the parent for nullable tails.

atoms.name: LL(1) table and conflicts
atoms.one_line: Cell by FIRST, ε-rules by FOLLOW; left recursion, common prefixes and ambiguity break it.

atoms.name: LR(0) items, CLOSURE, GOTO
atoms.one_line: Kernel plus closure; count items and states by following GOTO.

atoms.name: LR(0) and SLR(1) conflicts
atoms.one_line: LR(0) reduces everywhere; SLR reduces on FOLLOW; clash means shift and reduce share a terminal.

atoms.name: LR(1), LALR(1), CLR(1)
atoms.one_line: Exact lookaheads; LALR merges equal cores and can add reduce-reduce conflicts.

atoms.name: Precedence and associativity
atoms.one_line: Deeper rule binds tighter; recursion side sets associativity; evaluate level by level.
